name: verikora-monorepo
description: Verikora — your documents, read and checked by Sovkora: upload, keep, search, and every analysis traced to an Sovkora run.

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:workspace && turbo run lint && pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run check:code-names && ast-grep test --skip-snapshot-tests && krizaka-sg-ratchet && pnpm run format:check
scripts.check:i18n: krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/console && krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/documents && krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/legal && krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/marketing && krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/screening && krizaka-i18n check apps/web/messages/site && node scripts/merge-messages.mjs --check
scripts.check:code-names: krizaka-code-names apps/web/messages packages/client/src/messages apps/mobile/src/i18n apps/desktop/src/i18n apps/web/app/manifest.webmanifest
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test --filter='!./apps/mobile' -- --coverage.enabled --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=lcov && turbo run test --filter='./apps/mobile' && vitest run --coverage.enabled --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=lcov
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test

author: Krizaka
